comment: Pages that carry a route owned by one module but must stay in other modules' builds, because a page that IS in those builds imports them. Keep this list short: each entry is a coupling to remove. scripts/check-module-bundles.mjs fails if an entry is stale or a new leak appears.

pages.why: imported by pages/user/project-dashboard and pages/user/enroll-entities, which every module build includes

minOwnedPages.comment: Ratchet: pages whose routes a module owns (route path under its registry prefix). A route moved out of its prefix silently turns its page into a shared one that ships in every build; this stops that. Raise the numbers when more pages are assigned; never lower them to make the check pass.
